bullets: 3" X 20" REPAIR TAPE ROLL – Large peel-and-stick fabric repair tape can be cut to custom sizes for repairing tears, holes, worn areas, and damaged seams on outdoor gear.
AGGRESSIVE FABRIC ADHESIVE – Permanently bonds to nylon, polyester, vinyl, rubber, plastic, and technical fabrics to create durable repairs that stand up to outdoor adventures.
WATERPROOF & WEATHER-RESISTANT – Sealed with a waterproof coating that withstands rain, snow, moisture, and repeated outdoor use while maintaining a secure hold.
LONG-LASTING REPAIRS – Becomes machine washable after 24 hours and remains flexible without peeling or cracking, helping extend the life of expensive outdoor gear.
VERSATILE GEAR REPAIR – Ideal for repairing camping gear, hiking equipment, puffy jackets, rainwear, tents, tarps, luggage, hammocks, fishing gear, and more.
capture.description: Use Tenacious Tape to fix holes and tears quickly on technical and synthetic fabrics including vinyl, nylon, rubber and plastic gear. It’s a peel-and-stick, weatherproof repair tape that’s washable and won’t peel over time. It sticks to jackets, tents, and tarps; staying put no matter what Mother Nature dishes out. Instantly make a tent repair with Tenacious Tape in ripstop nylon or clear tape for a barely noticeable solution. Tenacious Tape also comes in a tough, flexible nylon fabric strip in a variety of colors, including OD green and coyote, for jackets, camping gear, and hunting outerwear (do not use on cotton or natural fabrics). For inflatables and sleeping pads requiring heavy-duty fixes, use puncture-resistant Tenacious Tape Flex Patches. When outdoor gear gets ripped or torn, Tenacious Tape will handle it – allowing you to stay outside longer.
